options.content: Data Platform Observability
ADF Overview

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let runs = ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated);

runs
| summarize
    SuccessfulDistinctPipelines = dcountif(PipelineName, Status == "Succeeded"),
    FailedDistinctPipelines = dcountif(PipelineName, Status == "Failed")

ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize
    Succeeded = countif(Status == "Succeeded"),
    Failed = countif(Status == "Failed")
| extend Total = Succeeded + Failed

ADFPipelineRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotnull(Start) and isnotnull(End) and End >= Start
| extend DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', End, Start)
| extend SLAStatus = iff(DurationMinutes > 30, "SLA Breached", "Within SLA")
| summarize
    TotalRuns = count(),
    SLA_Breached = countif(SLAStatus == "SLA Breached"),
    SuccessfulRuns = countif(Status == "Succeeded"),
    FailedRuns = countif(Status == "Failed"),
    AvgDurationMinutes = avg(DurationMinutes)
by PipelineName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

ADFActivityRun
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Status == "Failed"
| summarize FailureCount=count()
by ActivityType,PipelineName
| top 10 by FailureCount desc

ADFActivityRun
| where $__timeFilter( TimeGenerated)
| summarize
    TotalActivities=count(),
    FailedActivities=countif(Status=="Failed"),
    SuccessfulActivities=countif(Status=="Succeeded")
by ActivityType
| order by TotalActivities desc

options.content: ADB Overview

azureLogAnalytics.query:
DatabricksJobs
| extend Params = parse_json(RequestParams)
| extend JobId = tostring(Params["jobId"]),
         RunId = tostring(Params["runId"]),
         JobName = tostring(Params["taskKey"]),
         Status = tostring(Params["jobTerminalState"])
| where isnotempty(JobId) and isnotempty(RunId)
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Status == "Failed"
| summarize FailedCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

// -------- Bucket 1: FINAL STATUS PER JOB RUN --------
let DBX =
DatabricksJobs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend rp = parse_json(RequestParams), rs = parse_json(Response)
| extend action_lower = tolower(tostring(ActionName))
| extend ActionNorm = case(
    action_lower in ("runsucceeded","run_succeeded","jobrunsucceeded"), "Succeeded",
    action_lower in ("runfailed","run_failed","jobrunfailed"),         "Failed",
    ""
)
| where ActionNorm != ""
| extend RunId = coalesce(
    tostring(rp.run_id), tostring(rp.runId), tostring(rp["run-id"]), tostring(rp.RunId),
    tostring(rs.run_id), tostring(rs.runId), tostring(rs["run-id"]), tostring(rs.RunId)
)
| where RunId != "";

// FINAL event per RunId
let FinalRuns =
DBX
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ActionNorm) by RunId;

// OUTPUT FOR BIG LEFT TILES
FinalRuns
| summarize
    Succeeded = dcountif(RunId, ActionNorm == "Succeeded"),
    Failed    = dcountif(RunId, ActionNorm == "Failed"),
    Total     = dcount(RunId)
    | extend Total = Succeeded + Failed
    | extend Failure = iff(Total > 0,
                              todouble(Failed) * 100.0 / todouble(Total),
                              todouble(0))

DatabricksJobs
| summarize
    TotalActivities = count(),
    FailedActivities = countif(Response has "Failed")
| extend FailureRate = round((FailedActivities * 100.0) / TotalActivities, 2)
| extend PlatformHealth =
    case(
        FailureRate < 5, "Healthy",
        FailureRate < 10, "Moderate",
        "Critical"
    )

options.content: ADLS Overview

azureLogAnalytics.query:
StorageBlobLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize 
    Count = count() 
    by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval),
       Status = iff(StatusCode startswith "2", "Success", "Failure")
| evaluate pivot(Status, sum(Count))
| order by TimeGenerated asc

StorageBlobLogs
| where OperationName in ("PutBlob","PutBlockList","AppendBlock","FlushWithClose")
| summarize TotalDataGB = round(sum(RequestBodySize)/1024.0/1024/1024,2)
by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

StorageBlobLogs
| where OperationName in ("GetBlob","GetBlobProperties","ReadFile")
| summarize DataReadGB =
round(sum(ResponseBodySize)/1024.0/1024/1024,2)
by bin(TimeGenerated,1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

StorageBlobLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize lastWrite = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountName
| extend freshnessHours = datetime_diff("hour", now(), lastWrite)
| order by freshnessHours desc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics"
| where duration_d >0
| summarize AvgDuration_sec=avg(duration_d)/1000 by bin(TimeGenerated,1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

options.content: Synapse Overview

azureLogAnalytics.query:
SynapseIntegrationPipelineRuns
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize
    Succeeded = countif(Status == "Succeeded"),
    Failed = countif(Status == "Failed")
| extend Total = Succeeded + Failed
| extend Failure = iff(
    Total > 0,
    todouble(Failed) * 100.0 / todouble(Total),
    todouble(0)
)

SynapseIntegrationPipelineRuns
| summarize
    total_runs = count(),
    failed_runs = countif(Status == "Failed")
    by PipelineName
| extend failure_rate = round(100.0 * failed_runs / total_runs, 2)
| where total_runs > 5

SynapseIntegrationPipelineRuns
| where Start >= $__timeFrom()
| summarize runs = count() by PipelineName
| order by runs desc
| take 10
